title: Which driver will rank second in the Formula One drivers' championship immediately after the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix?
background: The drivers' championship standings reflect cumulative points earned during the season, with ties resolved under Formula One's championship rules.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The post-race drivers' championship standings published by the FIA or Formula One. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the driver ranked second in the championship standings following the Belgian Grand Prix scheduled for July 19, 2026, before any subsequent race takes place. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The driver's name.
